This email confirms the resolution of your request (Ticket C-1626):

1. **Shipping Correction**: Hardware has been reshipped to your designated site: **Rotterdam DC-VZZ1** (previously entered incorrectly).

Thank you for your patience. Contact us if you have further questions.

— IT Operations Team
